colorway.label: Colorway
colorway.describe: curated scheme, kit-coherent; sets all four zone albedos. smithy-iron = shipped dark blue-grey iron on warm oak, seasoned-oak = pale dry oak stump with a cream sawn top under the same iron, mossy-stump = dark damp log with green moss on the bark ring and down the cuts, red-oxide = anvil primed in red lead the way a working smith painted the body, on the shipped oak

iron.label: Iron
iron.describe: albedo of the entire anvil — body, face plate, horn and heel are one monochrome iron mass; the flat facets supply all value variation

wood.label: Stump flank
wood.describe: albedo of the stump flank and its bottom — the dominant wood tone over roughly 60% of the log surface

woodDark.label: Bark and cuts
woodDark.describe: albedo of the bark ring around the sawn top and of the carved notch and split interiors; reads as shadow inside the cuts, so keep it a step or two darker than the flank

cut.label: Sawn top
cut.describe: albedo of the freshly-sawn end grain the anvil stands on, inside the bark ring; the palest zone on the asset

hornLength.label: Horn length
hornLength.describe: how far the drooping horn reaches past the body, rebuilt at a constant 80 mm section pitch so a shorter horn sheds a whole cross-section ring (0.75 = stubby 234 mm beak on a 0.76 m asset and 4 rings, 1.0 = shipped 312 mm and 5 rings, 1.15 = long 359 mm beak on a 0.87 m asset). The root stays welded into the body block and the underside stays level, so only the top edge slope and the overall length change

stumpSides.label: Stump sides
stumpSides.describe: how many hewn flats the log is cut from, an odd count so no view is accidentally symmetric: 7 = chunky 51-degree faces with a strongly polygonal silhouette, 9 = shipped, 11 = finer 33-degree faces that read closer to a turned log. Drives the flank, the bark rim, the sawn top and the triangle count together

notches.label: Axe notches
notches.describe: integer count of slender carved leaf notches chopped around the flank, spread evenly over the segments the full-height split does not occupy (0 = a plain log with only the split, 4 = shipped, 6 = a heavily worked chopping block). The split itself is always present and is not counted here

materials_note: what each colour zone is made of: `kind` and `finish` name a procedural PBR material in https://polyfork.dev/materials.mjs (dressByAlbedo finds a zone by its albedo in COLOR_0). A zone not listed has not been classified.
